adopt: Wrap an environment you already have and ask it what happens next.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
An agent that cannot anticipate its environment can only react. Every framework that offers this makes you adopt its whole training stack to find out whether a learned model beats the lookup table you already have.

Install
pip install git+https://github.com/Aitherium/awpredict.git

Commands
  awpredict

Quick start
  pip install -e ".[torch]" # torch + numpy are optional; engines degrade loudly without them

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awpredict/
synopsis: Predict what your environment does next, and how surprised you were.
